district.name: Haveri
district.description: The gateway to North Karnataka, Haveri features Tarakeshwara Temple at Hangal with its 20-foot carved lotus ceiling, the Asia-renowned Byadgi chilli market, Kaginele Kanaka Guru Peetha, and Ranebennur Blackbuck Sanctuary.
district.descriptionKannada: ಉತ್ತರ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಹೆಬ್ಬಾಗಿಲು ಹಾವೇರಿ, ಹಾನಗಲ್ಲಿನ ತಾರಕೇಶ್ವರ ದೇವಾಲಯದ ೨೦ ಅಡಿ ಕೆತ್ತನೆಯ ಕಮಲದ ಮೇಲ್ಚಾವಣಿ, ಬ್ಯಾಡಗಿ ಮೆಣಸಿನಕಾಯಿ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಗಿನೆಲೆ ಕನಕ ಪೀಠಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಸರುವಾಸಿ.

destinations.name: Tarakeshwara Temple, Hangal
destinations.description: A breathtaking 12th-century Chalukyan temple dedicated to Shiva, renowned among architectural scholars for its colossal octagonal domed hall containing an astonishing 20-foot wide ceiling rosette carving shaped like a descending inverted lotus flower.
destinations.historicalSignificance: Built by the Western Chalukyas and patronized by the Hangal Kadambas; contains multiple hero stones (Veeragallu) depicting naval and cavalry battles.
destinations.culturalImportance: A supreme demonstration of stone lathe-turning and geometric symmetry in medieval Karnataka.
destinations.distanceFromNearestTown: 35 km from Haveri, 80 km from Hubballi
destinations.roadAccessibility: State Highway 2 connects Haveri to Hangal
destinations.safetyInstructions: Look up at the domed ceiling with a torch/phone light to appreciate the filigree lotus rosette.
destinations.permissionRequirements: Protected under Archaeological Survey of India

hiddenGemClassification.reason: Features the world's most intricate 20-foot stone inverted lotus ceiling, completely off the tourist radar.

destinations.name: Byadgi Red Chilli Market & Agricultural Yard
destinations.description: Asia's largest marketplace for red chillies, world-renowned for the GI-tagged Byadgi Chilli characterized by its wrinkled skin, deep ruby-red color (high oleoresin content), and low pungency, essential for South Indian cuisine and cosmetic extracts worldwide.
destinations.historicalSignificance: Trading hub since the Vijayanagara era; received Geographical Indication (GI) tag in 2011.
destinations.culturalImportance: A sensory spectacle on trading market days (Mondays & Thursdays) where oceans of deep red chillies are piled high across acres of auction yards.

photos.caption: Byadgi Red Chilli Market & Agricultural Yard
photos.source: Agricultural Produce Market Committee (APMC) Byadgi & Spice Board of India

destinations.bestSeason: December to March (Peak chilli harvest and trading season)
destinations.openingHours: 08:00 – 17:00 (Mondays and Thursdays are main auction days)
destinations.nearestRailwayStation: Byadgi Railway Station (1.5 km) / Haveri (18 km)
destinations.roadAccessibility: Situated right off NH-48 between Haveri and Davanagere
destinations.safetyInstructions: Wear a mask or face covering inside auction halls due to airborne chilli spice dust. Avoid touching eyes.
destinations.permissionRequirements: APMC open market yard, public entry
destinations.tourismInformationSource: Agricultural Produce Market Committee (APMC) Byadgi & Spice Board of India
